evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says: 'This should take me about five to ten minutes or so and then I can get you an after the estimate this will sound good to you.' (time frame present, promise of estimate, but 'sound good to you' is stated without waiting for explicit yes; rushed past.)
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics_name: Rep asks and collects name (Sylvia Zhang).
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics_date: Rep asks and collects October 3rd, Saturday.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics_route: Rep asks for origin (6801 Burnett Lane, Austin 78757) and destination (21301 West Koenig Lane, Austin 78756).
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics_size: Rep asks about unit type (1-bedroom apartment) and square footage (626 sq ft).
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks: 'Quick question other than the price or DM quote in general. Do you have any specific concerns or any important questions you want answers to on this call today?' — but this is asked AFTER probing for the origin address has already started. Customer replies: 'Oh, not really. I just wanted to get a quote. Yeah.' No concerns raised, so Two Layers Deep and Active Listening Reflection score N/A.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details: Rep gathers: property type (apartment, both origin and destination), bedroom count (1-bed), floor/elevator (5th floor with elevator at origin, 2nd floor with elevator at destination), square footage (626 sq ft). Rep does NOT ask about number of rooms (beyond bedrooms), walking distance, additional rooms beyond what's stated, or other special considerations. Partial.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep asks: 'As far as far as boxes go usually for one bedroom apartments, we see around fifteen to 25 boxes to be moved, you think you're going to be within that range.' Customer responds with estimated box count.
evidence_quotes.packing_services: No offer of packing services made.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides hourly rates ($230/hour Saturday, $210 Sunday, $208 weekdays) and minimum ($575 for Saturday, $525 for Sunday with 2.5-hour minimum), but does NOT personalize to this customer's move beyond rate differences by day. The anchor is given generically without reference to her stated budget concern or prep level. Partial.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep explains: 'the hourly rate... the rate does include absolutely everything... we don't have anything like a fuel fee, no disassemble reassembly fees, no hidden fees at all' and 'we have a minimum of two and a half hours, and then after that we prorate every fifteen minutes.' Both fee transparency and 2.5-hour minimum commitment present. Full.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or any version thereof. Not asked.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No Two Promises recap or closing loop confirmation. False.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep does not ask a final concerns check. Call ends with customer requesting quote be sent to email and asking about promotions. Not asked.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or similar catch-all. False.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any recognizable ask for the business. Instead, rep says 'I'll send that over to you in a bit and feel free to give us a call when you're ready to get scheduled.' This is a passive close with an out. Never.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: No booking is confirmed. Rep only commits to sending a quote email. Customer does not commit to a move date, crew size, or pickup/delivery window. None.

top_strength: Jules gathered all four core discovery basics early (name, date, origin/destination, unit type/size) and explained pricing transparency and rate structure clearly, so the customer understood exactly what was included and how the clock works.
coaching_note: Section 2's Their Agenda must be asked BEFORE probing starts (you asked it after the origin address was already in), and Sections 5, 6, and 7 were almost entirely skipped—no Two Promises, no final concerns check, and critically, no explicit ask for the business, which means the call ended with no commitment to book.
